rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296EA1F00000000}Are you going to start a war on this continent too?
Please stop this already.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296EB1F00000000}Start a war? Don't be ridiculous.
Look! There's already fighting
on this continent!

{C:81930200}{C:81958296ED1F00000000}That doesn't mean you can spread Claudia's war
to the other continents!

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296EF1F00000000}...It's for the world, and for that person...

{C:81930200}{C:81958296F01F00000000}That person?


{C:81930C00}{C:81958296F21F00000000}It's none of your concern.






{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296312000000000}Hey, young fellow!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296322000000000}...Who are you?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296332000000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Bouleuse Gotho.{C:819782830000}
Young fellow, how'd you like
to become an AT pilot?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296342000000000}What's an AT pilot?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296352000000000}You don't even know that?
And here I thought I was a good judge of people.
I sure got that wrong!

{C:81958296362000000000}Honestly!
All these folks coming from other continents
have brought no end of strange characters lately.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296372000000000}I'm sorry.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296382000000000}Oh, I don't mean you folks.
Don't worry about it.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296392000000000}Since we're already troubling you,
could I ask you something?
Do you know anyone who's good in a fight?


{C:81900300}{C:819582963A2000000000}Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:819582963B2000000000}We're bound to end up fighting here too,
so we'd be better off with someone strong on our side.

{C:81900300}{C:819582963D2000000000}That's true, but...

{C:8190CC00}{C:819582963E2000000000}Oh, so there's a story behind this.
Fighting, eh...? In that case,
he's your best bet.

{C:819582963F2000000000}Try this town's {C:819782830300}bar{C:819782830000} and ask for {C:819782830400}Chirico{C:819782830000}.
He's not very friendly,
but his skills are first-rate.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296412000000000}Chirico... you said?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296422000000000}What's wrong, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296432000000000}I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...
No, I must be imagining it.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296442000000000}Once you've met Chirico, come out to the 
{C:819782830300}outskirts{C:819782830000}.
That's where my shop is.

{C:81958296452000000000}Maybe fate brought us together here.
I'll help you out too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296462000000000}Thank you.
In any case, we'll try
looking for Chirico.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296472000000000}He's at this town's bar.
You'll spot him right away.
He sticks out like a sore thumb.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:819582965C2000000000}Someone who looks out of place here...
Maybe it's that man.

{C:81900300}{C:819582965D2000000000}Big brother, go ask him.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2000000000}Excuse me...
Um, are you Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582965F2000000000}I am.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296602000000000}Well, we'd like you
to help us in our fight.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296622000000000}I refuse.
You can't fight with women and children in tow.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296632000000000}Gotho told us about you.
Could you at least come with us
to the outskirts?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296642000000000}Gotho did...?
All right. I'll go with you.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296702000000000}...And that's why
we followed the Norstan here.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296722000000000}I see.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296732000000000}I see? Is that all you've got to say?
Can't you give them an answer,
like whether you'll help or not?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296742000000000}{C:819782830400}Fyana{C:819782830000} comes first. I have to get her back...

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296752000000000}What, you're still hung up on {C:819782830400}Phantom Lady{C:819782830000}?
Hey, hey, don't glare at me,
Chirico.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296762000000000}There's someone on the Norstan
that I want to get back too.

{C:81958296772000000000}To do that, we need people on this continent
who'll help us as well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782000000000}Big brother...

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296792000000000}...All right. I'll help you.
But you'll help me first.
That's my condition.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:819582967C2000000000}Hey, old man!
That sounds like an interesting conversation.
Let me in on it too!

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296150000000000}Oh, me too, me too!
Of course I'm joining in!

{C:8190C800}{C:819582967D2000000000}{C:819782830400}Coconna{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Vanilla{C:819782830000}...

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296160000000000}You're treating us like strangers,
Chirico, my boy.

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582967E2000000000}That's right, Chirico.
We're your friends, aren't we?

{C:8190CC00}{C:819582967F2000000000}There you have it.
Show a little gratitude, Chirico.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802000000000}So, what should we do?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296822000000000}First, there are two men: {C:819782830400}Murza{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830400}Byman.{C:819782830000}
Find them in the towns.
By then, {C:819782830400}Gregore{C:819782830000} should be back too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296832000000000}{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000} and {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000}, right?
Let's set out right away!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296862000000000}I've been asking around!
It sounds like that Murza fellow
is on the outskirts.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296872000000000}I see.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296882000000000}Well, well!
You're as cold as ever.
Don't I even get a thank-you?


{C:81930100}{C:819582968A2000000000}Thank you, {C:819782830400}Coconna.{C:819782830000}

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582968C2000000000}It's all right.
You don't have to be so considerate.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D2000000000}I'm really impressed.
We have such a hard time
getting even a scrap of information.

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582968E2000000000}Well, I'm from this continent,
after all.
You know what they say: to know a snake's ways, ask...

{C:81900400}{C:819582968F2000000000}A snake.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296912000000000}That's right, a snake.
You're a clever one.

{C:81958296922000000000}As long as you're on this continent,
leave information to me and supplies to the old man
or Vanilla, and you'll be fine.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942000000000}I see.
Then I'm counting on you when we're in trouble.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296952000000000}Oh, honestly!
You're so sweet and straightforward!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296962000000000}We're going.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296972000000000}Y-yes!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190DD00}{C:819582969E2000000000}Tch, this place has ended up like this too.
What a pitiful sight.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969F2000000000}Murza...

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296A02000000000}So that's it. The time has come.
Are you the only one here?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296A12000000000}Byman and Gregore are coming too.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296A22000000000}Tch, that bastard's coming too?
Well, fine.
So how are we getting around?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296A32000000000}Someone with a ship
has joined us.
Getting around will be easy.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296180000000000}I got here first and asked around.
That Byman guy's on 
{C:819782830300}Main Street{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296190000000000}He's so full of himself.
He really rubs me the wrong way!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A52000000000}Now, now, calm down.

{C:8190CB00}{C:819582961A0000000000}Oh, Rie!
Are you trying to comfort me?
You're so kind!

{C:819582961B0000000000}Maybe I ought to give you a kiss!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A62000000000}Big brooother!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72000000000}Vanilla!
Rie's still a child.
Please don't tease her!

{C:8190CB00}{C:819582961C0000000000}Ahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A82000000000}Come on, everyone, quit fooling around.
Let's go.
Chirico's already left!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A92000000000}But I wasn't fooling around...


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296AA2000000000}Byman.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296AC2000000000}And here I was enjoying my vacation.
I guess that's over now.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296AE2000000000}If you want out, suit yourself.
What's it going to be?

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296AF2000000000}You still can't take a joke,
can you?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296B02000000000}We're going.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296B12000000000}Yeah, yeah, I'm coming.
Even if it's straight to hell.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190E100}{C:81958296B62000000000}Can we really rely on
this man, {C:819782830400}Roger Smith{C:819782830000}?

{C:81906500}{C:81958296B72000000000}Hah!
Apparently he calls himself a renowned negotiator.
What do I care?

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296B92000000000}Posaydal's army shows poor judgment, too,
letting someone like that negotiate.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BA2000000000}Shut up!
It's obvious he'll fail.
That's when my job starts.

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296BC2000000000}A hostage, eh...? What a sneaky tactic.
I seem to recall that woman Nei
saying something similar.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BD2000000000}Don't lump me in
with that vixen!
I don't like you, old man.

{C:8190E100}{C:81958296BE2000000000}The feeling is mutual. It can't be helped.
We're only working together
because our interests coincide.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296BF2000000000}Hmph!





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296C52000000000}Gregore.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296C92000000000}Hey, is everyone here?
Still, every last one of you
has such a sour look on his face.

{C:8190DD00}{C:81958296CB2000000000}Look who's talking.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296CC2000000000}You look no different yourself.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296CF2000000000}Keep running your mouths!
Chirico, are you ready?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D12000000000}Our friends are getting everything ready
at the junk shop on the edge of town.

{C:8190DE00}{C:81958296D22000000000}Then shall we get going?




{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D42000000000}Thanks.

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296D52000000000}Don't mention it.
Not with the history you and I have.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D72000000000}The others will probably make
the adjustments themselves.

{C:81958296D82000000000}And another thing...


{C:81930100}{C:81958296D92000000000}What is it, Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296DB2000000000}We'll need some time to get ready.
Please wait until then.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DC2000000000}I understand.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296E42000000000}I'll get straight to the point.
The terms from Posaydal's army
are as follows.

{C:81958296E52000000000}Cease attacks on Posaydal's army.
Surrender the Astante, GTs and FTs.

{C:81958296E62000000000}In return,
they will cease attacks on Claudia
and hand over Lun Forest. That's all.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E72000000000}That's so one-sided!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E82000000000}If we only consider Claudia,
those terms might be reasonable.
That doesn't mean I intend to accept them.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E92000000000}But is it all right for us
to decide something this important?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA2000000000}...Let's refuse.
Maybe this really isn't
our decision to make.

{C:81958296EB2000000000}But just because it would save Claudia,
that's no reason for us
to abandon the other continents.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296EC2000000000}Hahahahahahaha!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296ED2000000000}What's so funny?!

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296EE2000000000}Hahaha... My apologies.
You're more decent than I expected,
and that made me happy.

{C:81958296EF2000000000}Anyone who'd accept terms like these
can't be a decent person.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F12000000000}Then why did you
take this job?

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F22000000000}Because I'm a negotiator.
I accept any request.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32000000000}I can't believe you...

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F42000000000}Well, negotiations have broken down.
Sorry to trouble you, but when it's convenient, could you take me to 
{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000}?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F52000000000}And you've got some nerve, too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62000000000}Ahahaha... Sure.
But we've got something to do first,
so it'll have to be after that.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F72000000000}Thank you. That helps.



{x00}

Please transport us there.

{C:81958296082100000000}From there, we'll use the {C:819782830400}LCT{C:819782830000}

{C:8190DD00}{C:819582960B2100000000}We came together for a reason.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2100000000}What did you say?!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296112100000000}I'd rather not say this,

{C:81958296132100000000}Sorry, kid.

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296192100000000}We appreciate the thought.
